art_direction: 一件青瓷器以两只相连的浅碗组成，口沿高低错落，灰绿釉柔和。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Model a small celadon vessel formed from two shallow bowls joined at their sides. One bowl is slightly taller, giving the rim a gentle wave when viewed from three-quarter angle. Use a muted gray-green glaze with a few subtle thickness variations near the foot. Place it on a quiet warm-gray surface and light it with one broad overhead source. Let the empty bowl interiors provide the main shape contrast. Avoid food, flowers, patterns, visible logos, or a crowded ceramic display. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
